summary.text: Mika Stilwell is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent David Buehler (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a working mother of four.

paragraphs.text: Stilwell graduated from Olathe Northwest High School and attended Heritage College, graduating in 2012, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as pharmacy; she won the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she supports fully funding special education, expanding safety net programs such as Medicaid, WIC and SNAP, and a moratorium on data centers.
She named public education, disability and healthcare as areas of policy interest.
